title: Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换

quiz.q: Which transformations take y=x2 to y=−21​(x+2)2−3?y=x2 经过哪些变换得到 y=−21​(x+2)2−3？
opts: stretch by 21​, reflect in x-axis, left 2, down 3纵向压缩为 21​，关于 x 轴对称，向左平移 2，向下平移 3
stretch by 2, reflect in x-axis, right 2, down 3纵向拉伸为 2 倍，关于 x 轴对称，向右平移 2，向下平移 3
stretch by 21​, right 2, down 3纵向压缩为 21​，向右平移 2，向下平移 3
stretch by 21​, reflect in y-axis, left 2, up 3纵向压缩为 21​，关于 y 轴对称，向左平移 2，向上平移 3
quiz.hint: a=−21​, p=−2, q=−3.a=−21​，p=−2，q=−3。
quiz.ans: vertical stretch by a factor of 21​, reflection in the x-axis, 2 left, 3 down竖直伸缩为原来的 21​，关于 x 轴翻折，向左 2，向下 3
quiz.why: Negative a reflects in the x-axis; (x+2) is 2 left; −3 is 3 down.a 为负 → 关于 x 轴翻折；(x+2) → 向左 2；−3 → 向下 3。

quiz.q: Write the equation of the parabola with vertex (−1,4) passing through (1,−4).求顶点为 (−1,4)、经过 (1,−4) 的抛物线方程。
quiz.hint: −4=a(1+1)2+4
quiz.ans: y=−2(x+1)2+4
quiz.why: −4=4a+4⇒a=−2.−4=4a+4⇒a=−2。

quiz.q: The graph of y=x2 is stretched vertically by a factor of 3, reflected in the x-axis, then moved 5 left and 2 down. Its equation is:y=x2 的图象竖直拉伸为原来的 3 倍，关于 x 轴翻折，再向左平移 5、向下平移 2。所得方程是：
opts: y=−3(x−5)2−2
y=−3(x+5)2−2
y=3(x+5)2−2
y=−31​(x+5)2−2
quiz.hint: Left 5 means p=−5, so the bracket is (x+5).向左 5 即 p=−5，括号是 (x+5)。
quiz.ans: y=−3(x+5)2−2
quiz.why: a=−3, p=−5, q=−2.a=−3，p=−5，q=−2。

quiz.q: A parabola has axis of symmetry x=−1 and passes through (1,2) and (2,−3). Find its equation.一条抛物线的对称轴是 x=−1，经过 (1,2) 和 (2,−3)。求它的方程。
quiz.hint: y=a(x+1)2+q; substitute both points and subtract.设 y=a(x+1)2+q，代入两点后相减。
quiz.ans: y=−(x+1)2+6
quiz.why: 2=4a+q and −3=9a+q. Subtract: −5=5a, so a=−1, q=6.2=4a+q，−3=9a+q。相减：−5=5a，a=−1，q=6。

quiz.q: A skateboard ramp profile is y=0.5(x−4)2 (metres), for 0≤x≤4. How high is the ramp where it starts (x=0), and how far from the start is it 2 m high?滑板坡道的剖面是 y=0.5(x−4)2（米），0≤x≤4。起点（x=0）有多高？离起点多远处高 2 m？
quiz.hint: Solve 0.5(x−4)2=2 and keep the root in 0≤x≤4.解 0.5(x−4)2=2，保留 0≤x≤4 内的根。
quiz.ans: 8 m high at the start; 2 m high at x=2起点高 8 m；在 x=2 处高 2 m
quiz.why: y(0)=0.5(16)=8.y(0)=0.5(16)=8。
